98 separately practicable tasks; 78/78 census leaves covered. Raw ask scan: 96 lines, with two rhetorical passage lines exempted as narrative and retained in full context.

All ten Q5 questions, all eight Rutherford passage tasks, and all four 28-mark Q12 alternatives retained. Internal any-N choices remain one card with every accepted choice and the published stepped tariff.

All seven force–acceleration pairs, complete steam experiment measurements, all four lens data pairs and all three wire diameter readings retained. Rollercoaster, wave, capacitor circuit, kettle, X-ray tube and solenoid diagrams retain every required label, value and assumption.

Both complete resonance experiment routes retain their 14-mark tariffs. Both capacitor-energy demonstration routes retain their 12-mark tariffs. All four material–charge-carrier pairs form one ten-mark matching card, with 6/2/1/1 steps.

The malformed scheme diameter table is not substituted for the original paper table. The resistance equation retains the original fraction. Source solution figures show complete formulae and partial-credit working.

Historical SEC answers retained alongside visible clarifications: Rutherford alpha deflection is electric repulsion; an oil-film example is thin-film interference. Scientific checks: https://history.aip.org/exhibits/rutherford/sections/alpha-particles-atom.html and https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/3-4-interference-in-thin-films.
